task.title: Plan storage, logs, and backup evidence
task.shortdesc: Locate the source-deployment database, schema cache, documentation site, foreground logs, and manual backup evidence without claiming managed backup or restore support.

prereq.p: The deployment configuration inventory includes BPM_DATABASE_URL, BPM_SCHEMA_CACHE_DIR, and BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR.

context.p: The default source deployment stores application data in SQLite at sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/bpm.db, corresponding to data/bpm.db under the repository root. Schema cache files live under app/schemas/mozilla by default, and an installed documentation artifact is read from app/documentation/site when present.

step.cmd: Identify the files and directories that hold operational state.

info.p: Record the repository path, data/, data/bpm.db, app/schemas/mozilla, and app/documentation/site. In WSL, keep these paths in the Linux filesystem rather than under /mnt/c.

step.cmd: Define a manual backup evidence step before risky work.

info.p: Stop the foreground BPM process, copy data/bpm.db to a controlled backup location, and record timestamp, source revision, database URL, file size, and checksum. BPM 0.9.0 does not provide automated backup, point-in-time recovery, or tested restore orchestration.

step.cmd: Capture logs from the current source process.

info.p: Source runs write startup messages, Uvicorn access output, tracebacks, migration errors, port conflicts, and documentation-site warnings to the foreground terminal, stdout, or stderr. No dedicated BPM application log directory, log rotation policy, request ID, audit log, or Event Viewer integration is documented in this release.

step.cmd: Pair file backup evidence with export evidence when profile handoff matters.

info.p: Use existing API export examples to export relevant Firefox policies.json documents and store response status, profile ID, revision, schema channel, and exported-document hash. Do not treat export evidence as a complete database restore.

result.p: The administrator knows where current source-deployment state lives and which manual evidence can be collected before updates or troubleshooting.

postreq.p: Before changing source revisions or database schemas, use the future update-from-source runbook and stop when backup or restore evidence is incomplete.
